note: Static contract inventory. Every listed operation is proposed unless contracts.csv marks it existing; none of the behaviours below has been implemented or run. Each schema root rejects every instance, so payloads are only valid through #/$defs fragments.

schemas.purpose: Native account with initial password and forced first change, separate administrator password reset, server session, CSRF, explicit historical subject mapping, independent operator/platform_admin grants, revocation versions, and the last-active-administrator conflict projection returned by the server.
schemas.implementationAmendment: P2-04 adds native roleGrantStatusRequest; original-plan remains unchanged

schemas.purpose: Operation-bound re-verification for real command execution (assessment, execution request digest, profile id/version, incident, actual command digest) and for user, source, cluster, registry, execution-profile and MFA operations with their own target projections and no invented risk assessments; server-owned method policy and accumulated password plus TOTP state; MFA enrolment confirmation ordered after a password+TOTP challenge; recovery codes bound to a challenge id; administrator MFA reset with a write-time recheck record.

Independent observability query lifecycle without an AI conversation: fixed resource identity with an explicit namespaced or cluster-scoped scope, source registration and credential revision, absolute half-open window, coverage, population versus bounded samples, result publication only on completion, cancel request versus confirmed termination, expiry and re-authorization record.

Four user-facing model fields with a plain integer or null context window and an explicit credential keep/replace action, OpenBao-controlled credential without echo, separation of connection/admission/task/quality expressed by distinct fields and absent cross-effects, no fabricated admission for unknown models, and a new job envelope freezing one admitted profile reference plus worker capability shared by API, Go worker and Python dispatcher.
rejectedClientClaims: admission or quality verdict in a connection test

crossFieldRuntimeChecks.check: login name uniqueness and tenant resolution come only from installation configuration
Argon2id parameter version, persistent failure rate limiting and identical unknown-user/wrong-password errors
session rotation, HttpOnly/Secure cookie, Origin and CSRF validation on every write
first_password_only session may reach only password change and logout
historical subject mapping uniqueness, evidence link and no role inheritance by login name
last-administrator decision is taken inside the write transaction; the client sees accountUpdateConflict and cannot influence the count
credential, session and authorization versions increment and invalidate older sessions immediately
challenge binds operation, target identity and revision; command execution additionally binds the real risk assessment, command digest, incident, execution profile version and policy version
administrative and MFA operations never construct a fake command risk assessment
required methods are derived by the server from the operation policy; clients cannot lower them
acr urn:ops:loa:2 only after the current challenge accumulated both password and TOTP; a single TOTP or a previous login does not count
verify happens before any business write; each high-risk write records its own writeRecheck in its transaction
TOTP provisioning material is returned only by the creation response and never by later status reads
recovery code yields loa:1, revokes existing sessions and forces MFA re-enrolment
window to is later than from and the window does not exceed the source maxWindowSeconds
canonical ID, UID, namespace UID and cluster UID all match the registered resource; recreated resources do not hit old results
source registration active, credential revision current and qualification digest matching
query state machine, late result rejection and cancel receipt confirmation
population count comes from an aggregate or full scan, never from sample rows, returned or truncation
history read re-authorizes and re-checks source qualification; expired results return result_expired
baseURL keeps the existing modelprofile address constraints and the credential is written to and never read back from OpenBao
manual context window may only tighten a measured limit; unknown stays unknown
connection test never changes admission evidence and quality is recorded separately
new job freezes the profile reference; API, Go worker and Python dispatcher compare the same reference and worker capability
credential keep leaves OpenBao untouched; replace writes a new version; create requires replace and no response echoes the secret
a null context window triggers provider detection; the measured maximum and source are server facts and can only tighten the value
cluster-scoped resources carry null namespace and namespace UID; namespaced resources carry both and are checked against the registry
only a completed query publishes a result; cancelled, terminated, failed, running and expired reads expose no stored result and discard late results
result status derives from the measured population for log results and from not_applicable for metric/resource/hardware results; empty samples never imply no match
administrator password reset is its own operation: initial password, expected revision and credential version, forced change and session version bump
command challenges match assessmentId, riskAssessmentVersion, executionRequestDigest, executionProfileId and integer executionProfileVersion, actualCommandDigest, policyVersion and incident
source, cluster, registry and execution-profile administration challenges target their own projections and carry no command binding
MFA confirmation requires a completed password+TOTP challenge bound to the enrolment and current session before the new TOTP is accepted
recovery verification resolves the challenge from the request challenge id and expected revision, not from a cookie alone
administrator MFA reset may revoke zero sessions but must bump credential and session versions; the count is not the security proof
